relationships.explanation_en: Quality preference retains a price condition; the later letter explicitly discusses overpayment. This is a thematic comparison, not a claim that one passage formally revises the other.
Within the same exchange Munger adds the risk of persistently poor index returns at high prices. The two speakers remain distinct.
The selected sources address both personal qualities and organizational pressures. This is editorial comparison, not a diagnostic test for integrity.

not_reviewed: All other passages and topics in the full library
Any current market valuation, product cost or suitability
Audio recordings and precise timestamp synchronization
Independent truth of the speakers’ historical numerical examples
approval_scope: Selected claims, their qualifiers and textual attribution only; no blanket approval of context or corpus.
